page.overview:
Who is The Crows?

The are the rival gang to the Mad Gear Gang, introduced in Street Fighter 6 and led by Rudra. They are based out of an area in Metro City known as the .

According to both Rudra and Chandi, the Crows are a "gang" only by technicality -- they're actually a group of orphaned and homeless youth who were rescued by Rudra at one point or another. They steal and use violence only as a means to survive and protect themselves and their turf from other gangs. However, they are well aware that crimes are crimes, regardless of the reason, so when people began calling them another "gang" like Mad Gear and the Canary Crates, they decided to roll with it.

According to Chandi, they used to live in another town until they were driven out and were forced to settle in Metro City. Rudra chose the name "Crows" after an experience where a murder of crows came together and attacked him after he repeatedly stole eggs from their nests looking for food. Impressed by their intelligence, coordination and tenacity, and feeling that the number of eggs he ate makes him part Crow himself, Rudra chose that as the name for his group.
